fields.label: App
fields.description: The app that owns this event, for example the app's technical name. Used to group events in pickers.

fields.label: Key
fields.description: Short code for the event, unique within the app (letters, numbers, dots, underscores). Automations match on app and key, so avoid renaming it.

fields.label: Business Name
fields.description: The plain-language name people see when choosing this event, for example Customer purchase.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Active events fire automations. Deprecated events still fire, with a warning, until you move automations to the replacement.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Goes up by one when a source is removed, so older automations can be spotted. Adding things keeps the version.

fields.label: Replaced By
fields.description: Set when this event is deprecated: the event automations should use instead.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: What happens in the business when this event fires, in one or two sentences.

fields.label: Payload Fields
fields.description: Describes the data sent with the event (field name to description). Shown to people building automations.

fields.label: Personal Data Fields
fields.description: List of payload field names that contain personal data, so they can be hidden from logs.

fields.label: Sources
fields.description: Document changes that fire this event. Leave empty if an app fires it directly.
